newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Whittier City SD, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Whittier City SD, Calif.

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL CERTIFICATES OF PARTICIPATI
County of Los Angeles, State of California
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, pursuant to California Government Code Section 53692, that the Board of Education of the Whittier City School District, Los Angeles County,

California, intends to sell $5,350,000* principal amount of Whittier City School District Certificates of Participation (1997 School Facilities Project) representing the direct, undivided fractional interests of the registered owners thereof in lease payments to be made by the Whittier City School District pursuant to a Lease Agreement entered into between the District and the Whittier City School District Financing Corporation, a non-profit public benefit

corporation organized and operating under the laws of the State of California. Bids will be received on at 10:00 a.m., at the offices of Dale Scott & Company, Inc., 400 Montgomery Street, Suite 805, San Francisco, CA 94104, telephone (415) 956-1030 or by facsimile at (415) 956-1322, and the sale will be awarded by the Superintendent of the Whittier City School District or his/her designee on behalf of the Board of Education of the Whittier City School District within twenty-six (26) hours after the bid opening is completed. In the event that the Superintendent or his/her authorized designee does not award a bid on the date specified above, proposals will be received the following Wednesday at the same time and place specified above and each Wednesday thereafter until such time as a bid is awarded or notice to the contrary is given. Further
information, including copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Official Notice of Sale and Bid Form, may be obtained from the Financial Advisor at the above address.
